sentences.en: The company invited their prospective customers to the party.
sentences.zh: 公司邀请了潜在客户参加派对。

sentences.en: Prospective buyers couldn't make heads or tails out of the contract.
sentences.zh: 潜在买家对那份合同摸不着头脑。

sentences.en: We have several prospective new members. I hope they will join us.
sentences.zh: 我们有几个潜在的新成员。希望他们能加入我们。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pro（向前）+spect（看）+ive（…的）→向前看的→未来的
